[[Enchanted Spear]]s are aggressive animated pairs of [[spear]] and [[shield]] which float above the ground with no apparent supporting creature. They can be very dangerous if a group of them focuses fire on a [[squishy]] [[backline]] character.

==Locations==
*[[Depths of Tyria]]
**{{NPC location|Cathedral of Flames}} (levels 2 and 3)
**{{NPC location|Slavers' Exile}} (Forgewight's level)
